name: auto-learn
description: Learns skills from your work: after a turn that worked out something reusable, a background fork of the session saves the procedure as a personal skill that Codex offers in later sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Saves procedures that worked as personal skills
interface.longDescription: After a turn with enough tool calls, a background fork of the session reviews the turn and saves what it worked out as a skill in ~/.agents/skills, which Codex offers in later sessions. The model can also save skills itself with the manage_skill tool.
